Runtime dependencies: Qiskit, PennyLane, Gurobi/CP-SAT, Slurm, CUDA, CBOM tooling. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Dataq Quanta follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
The next step is small and real: one working session on Dataq Quanta architecture, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
